name: @picketai/picket
description: Picket: a software-development workflow for Claude Code with four lanes, four agents and one kernel.
author: Vlad Apetre

scripts.version: node .github/scripts/release.mjs sync-version && git add core/.claude-plugin/plugin.json status/.claude-plugin/plugin.json session/.claude-plugin/plugin.json
scripts.test:status: claude plugin validate --strict status && claude plugin test status
scripts.test:session: claude plugin validate --strict session && claude plugin test session
